CURRENT execution/enforcement surfaces extend beyond the historical function-body inventory, including an active scheduled queue worker and 13 enabled governance-related row triggers.

The initially suspicious assessment/proposal UPDATE currentness path intentionally delegates from a specialized currentness trigger to broader final UPDATE guards. Those final guards explicitly reject unless continuation currentness and full-manifest currentness hold. The hypothesized missing UPDATE-currentness control is therefore not demonstrated.

Both final-guard paths converge on shared manifest reconstruction/currentness helpers. The manifest is freshly rebuilt from canonical graph/source references; full-manifest currentness requires exact JSON and digest equality with the pinned run snapshot; continuation currentness separately evaluates contract, policy, manifest and status-dependent authority dimensions.

VALIDATING continuation uses a narrower currentness decision than COMPLETED lifecycle currentness, but Q23 found zero CURRENT VALIDATING rows and the run guard constrains invalidation, manifest mutation, transitions and completion freshness. No reachable CURRENT stale-VALIDATING counterexample was demonstrated.

CURRENT source implements SHA-bound request/transaction-local canonical-graph reuse and identity-keyed freshness-delta reuse with recomputation on cache-key mismatch and explicit cleanup/counters. These are implementation-proven mechanisms, not inferred from cached-function names.

Validator-evidence compaction is content-addressed and representation-only by checked rehydration equivalence. Its observed migration completed VERIFIED over 10131 baseline-eligible assessments with exhaustive verification and zero unmatched receipt hashes.

The bounded queue mechanism is operational. Eight observed requests are DONE at the queue layer, with six final BLOCKED and two READY outcomes and no recorded error codes. Their heterogeneous wall times are observations, not a speed benchmark.

Queue operation and verified compaction both predate the P0 cutoff. Several cached/recuration function names are positively present in the P0 event. Request-local-state tokens are absent from that event, but absence cannot establish post-P0 creation because queue/compaction provide a direct counterexample to event-token completeness.

s2_decision.label: MEASURE_FIRST
s2_decision.rationale: No demonstrated defect satisfies REPAIR_REQUIRED. The principal unresolved claim is whether the evolved mechanisms deliver a causal optimization benefit; current telemetry cannot establish that. Because S2 orders MEASURE_FIRST ahead of VERIFY_CRITICAL and no actual critical exposure route is demonstrated, MEASURE_FIRST is the governing disposition.
